name: basic_readings

expect.contains:
Adafruit MPU6050 test!
MPU6050 Found!
Accelerometer range set to: +-8G
Gyro range set to: +- 500 deg/s
Filter bandwidth set to: 21 Hz

Acceleration X: 0.00, Y: 4.90, Z: 8.49 m/s^2
Rotation X: 0.00, Y: 0.00, Z: 0.79 rad/s
Temperature: 24.00 degC

Rotation X: 0.00, Y: 0.00, Z: 0.79 rad/s

description: Adafruit's MPU6050 basic_readings, unmodified: the library finds WHO_AM_I 0x68 at 0x68, resets the part (polling DEVICE_RESET), wakes it on the gyro PLL, sets +-8 g, +-500 deg/s and the 21 Hz filter, then prints every half second. Tilted 30 degrees (0.5 g on Y, 0.866 g on Z) and turning at 45 deg/s about Z, it reads 4.90 and 8.49 m/s^2 and 0.79 rad/s (2948 LSB at 65.5 LSB per deg/s); laid on its side at 1.2 s, -9.81 m/s^2 on X.
